notes:
{前|まえ} means front (spatial) and before (temporal). A fundamental word with many uses.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前|まえ}: front, before
- ⟦{後|うしろ}→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧: behind (spatial)
- ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧: after (temporal)

TIME PATTERNS:
- ～{前|まえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: before ~
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧＋{前|まえ}: ~ ago (e.g., ⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧{前|まえ})

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {前|まえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to move forward
- {前|まえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}く→向く：02304_muku⟧: to face forward, look ahead
- ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧: in front of the station
